三个类别独立订阅与调频，支持 1–300 Hz 和小数。请求频率是目标，不保证实: The three categories subscribe and change rates independently, from 1 to 300 Hz, including fractions. Requested rates are targets, not guaranteed throughput.
位置、骨骼和相机保留各自的采样序号和时间，缺失值不沿用。实体身份按 Reader: Positions, skeletons and camera keep their own capture sequence and timing. Missing values clear previous values. Entity identities are scoped by Reader instance and epoch.
VALORANT Reader 等待订阅数据: VALORANT Reader waiting for subscription data
雷达底图加载失败: Could not load radar map image
拖动移动地图，滚轮或加减键缩放，Home 恢复视图。: Drag to pan. Use the wheel or plus/minus keys to zoom. Press Home to reset the view.
地图来自当前 Reader 上下文。已核验的本地与队伍关系用于着色，未知关系保持: Maps use current Reader context. Confirmed local and team relationships determine colors; unknown relationships remain unclassified. Without a map image, the view shows relative positions and does not infer walls or floors.
本地人物来自实际控制关系，相机与观战目标不用于推断自己。原生队伍 0 是有效值，: The local character uses actual control relationships, independently of camera or spectator targets. Native team 0 is a valid value; missing teams remain unknown.
ESP 与 Radar 共用。仅使用 Reader 明确的本地身份及队伍关系；未: Shared by ESP and Radar. Uses explicit Reader identity and relationships; unclassified does not mean enemy, bot or dead.
相机与本地身体分开记录；死亡或观战时，相机不作为自己的身体。此开关控制 Rada: The camera is separate from the local body, including spectating. This switch controls the camera marker on Radar.
叠加层按本机进程名查找前台窗口，不使用远端游戏 PID。Reader 位于远端时: The overlay finds a local foreground window by executable name, independently of the remote game PID. Embedded ESP supports a remote Reader; overlays only cover a local game.
0 表示米制比例未知，距离按 Reader 原生单位 u 显示。只有明确填入米/: Zero means the metric scale is unknown. Distances use native units (u) until an explicit scale is configured for meters and distance filtering.
ESP 使用当前相机位置、欧拉角和原生镜头参数重建投影，不是 Reader 提供: ESP reconstructs projection from the current camera pose and lens. It is not a final screen matrix from Reader. Adjust aspect and FOV axis in ESP; missing or unknown camera projections clear old geometry.
仅画本批有效的 22 点及已知父子连线。骨点范围不是 Hitbox，缺点不补旧值: Draws current valid joints and known parent edges from the 22-joint layout. Bounds represent sampled joints. Missing values are cleared; positions and skeletons remain independent.
距离从当前相机到人物根坐标计算；缺根坐标时使用当前有效骨点。未设置米制比例时以原: Distance is measured from the camera to the current root position, or a valid current joint when the root is missing. Unknown metric scales use native units (u).
0 表示不限。米制比例在游戏设置中明确设置后可用。: Zero means unlimited. Requires an explicit metric scale in game settings.
按 UE 相机坐标约定解释欧拉角及 FOV，原生画幅约束生效时保持对应比例。这是: Uses the UE camera convention, Euler angles and FOV, preserving a constrained camera aspect. This is a client reconstruction; zoom and special viewport behavior require visual verification.
